newsitem.title: USA: United Video sees Q4 meeting consensus.
newsitem.headline: United Video sees Q4 meeting consensus.

text.p: United Video Satellite Group Inc said Wednesday it expects its fourth-quarter earnings to meet the Wall Street consensus of $0.24 per share. In the same year-ago period it earned $0.17 per share.
"Business is great and we expect to have a very solid fourth quarter in line with previous expectations," president Roy Bliss said.

The provider of satellite-delivered video, audio, data and program promotion services also said its board authorized the repurchase from time to time of up to one million shares of Class A common stock.
It said the repurchases would be made with existing cash. At September 30, the company had 37.0 million average shares outstanding.

"The market has grossly overreacted to threats to our WGN superstation distribution, and we are optimistic that United Video Satellite Group and WGN will be able to provide cable operators with substantial additional value by providing local advertising avails (available time slots for advertising) to cable operators in the near future."
